# Status INFLUENCED: the expectations were formed from source reading (D003 touches only failure paths ->
#   the non-failure outputs are expected to be byte-identical) and from the S5R3 unit count, not from a blind trial.
# Written before the first formal run; sha256 recorded in PREREG_RELR1.tsv.sha256.txt; no row is rewritten later.

# in {B,F4};

in {1,2}; example ids replace '/' with '__' and drop the .lua suffix.
# Suites: T1 make test (per tree, 2 passes); T2 runtests.sh and its 3 independent references;
#   T3 examples; T4 P04 pipeline (F4 only); T5 P04 unit tests; T6 C API; T7 fresh clone; T8 optional D003 E2E.
#   MAKETEST_UNIT_STATUS: per unit name status (ok/FAIL/ERROR/skipped) compared across the four passes;
#     unit_count must equal 'Ran N' (reconciliation) and is compared with the S5R3 value 265.
#   BYTE_IDENTICAL_ELSE_NUMDIFF_1E-12: sha256 of stdout/stderr must be equal; if not, numdiff with relative
#     tolerance 1e-12 decides DIFF_WITHIN_TOL, otherwise DIFF.  Same-tree two-pass difference = FLAKY.
#   REFERENCE_NUMDIFF_<tol>: compare stdout to the committed reference with that tolerance (independent reference).
#   AGGREGATE_JSON_PASS: the P04 aggregate AGGREGATE.json verdict field must be PASS.
#   STATUS_EQUAL: the two trees must give the same status (or F4 better); no golden reference exists.
#   RECORD_ONLY: U tree cannot be built (U_BUILD_UNAVAILABLE); recorded, not judged (task brief section 5).
